services.name: Beach Chair
services.desc: Get every member of your family out on the beach! The sand, sea breeze, and beautiful sunsets are accessible to everyone. Just book a beach wheelchair! Are you worried about cruising through deep sand? No need to stress. Our wheelchairs are equipped to take on soft sand with large balloon tires, so take in the coastal beaches of Sarasota today! How will you get your beach wheelchair? For rental periods of three days or longer, we provide delivery services to Sarasota, Manatee and Charlotte County. Delivery is free on Siesta Key. For customers at all other locations, we charge a delivery fee. See our FAQ page for pricing. Having a wedding on the beach? Ask us about our special event delivery

services.name: Paddle boards
services.desc: Experience nature up close by being on the water. Whether you want to paddle the Little Sarasota Bay, the Gulf of Mexico or someplace near where you’re staying, we can make it happen. Paddle boarding is another excellent way to see Sarasota from a different perspective. Launching from either Turtle Beach Boat Launch or one of our beach locations on Siesta Key, paddle boarding gives you a more laid back and easygoing chance to see the area along the water. Because of the lightweight and portability of the boards, you can always take a break and explore on solid land if you want too! services.name: Kayak Tour
services.desc: Explore nature in Siesta Key, Florida up close. Whether you want to paddle the Little Sarasota Bay, the Gulf of Mexico, or paddle through mangrove tunnels and search for manatees, we’ve got you covered. We offer kayak rentals of quality, single and double kayaks. We launch kayaks from Turtle Beach on Siesta Key. We will deliver a kayak to where you are staying. We offer kayak tours, kayak classes, and more! Join us for a kayak tour! Paddle around the Jim Neville Marine Preserve to experience some of Florida’s best nature.
